aligned.tex.caption:
Identity-column repair F1 under aligned and whole-table information. Aligned uses the same chunks,
  20 labeled tuples and error positions; Baran is the mean of three runs. Whole-table Baran
  uses perfect detection. TabClean uses DeepSeek-V4-Pro with development rows excluded.

beers.tex.caption: Beers identity-column repair F1, O$-$S contrasts and repaired cities (O/F/W/S, of 127). $^\dagger$: Holm-corrected $p<0.05$ across eight O$-$S contrasts using entity/reply weights. F is descriptive; its brewery and alcohol-content distributions differ from O.

checks.tex.caption: Acceptance checks, run on every controlled table before any model sees it: 506 checks over 21 tables.

construction.tex.caption:
Controlled-table sources and scale. Parentheses give error counts in identity columns;
  values renamed are distinct one-to-one replacements. Seeds cover F, W and S.

counts.tex.caption: Repaired cells and chunk wins:losses, excluding ties. Hospital compares W/S on 219 identity errors; Movies compares O/W on 379. Hospital chunk counts are descriptive; Movies sign tests use Holm correction over eight models.

decomposition.tex.caption: Identity-column repair F1 at seed 0. F$-$W uses nonpaired fresh records; O/W/S contrasts are paired. $^\dagger$: Holm-corrected $p<0.05$ over 40 contrasts, using 50,000 entity/reply bootstrap reweightings (Section~\ref{sec:setup}).

detection.tex.caption:
Detection and repair diverge on surrogate identity columns. Entries give detection F1 /
  repair F1; detection counts corrupted cells found regardless of the value proposed for that cell.

example.tex.caption:
Hospital identity fields across conditions, with the corrupted city in bold.
  O/W/S share a row and error position. $^*$F draws a newer registry row with updated quality
  measures, rather than a row-paired replacement of O.

moviescols.tex.caption:
DeepSeek-V4-Pro Movies repairs by column (repaired / errors). Identity columns
  are listed first; each condition uses its own error counts.

near.tex.caption: Director rewrite rates among known films and city rewrite rates among known Hospital/Beers entities, with one row per target. Brackets give 95\% reply-cluster percentile intervals. All-or-none outcomes show rewritten/known counts instead of intervals.

p1.tex.caption:
Highest hard-cell continuation accuracy over datasets for each context.
  Columns distinguish clean/dirty context, dataset naming and error-row selection.
  Leakage counts clean reference values written from dirty context.

publicverification.tex.caption:
Offline calculations for the three analyses. Movies uses numerical witnesses
  for cleaning and conflict results, and saved counts for the continuation probe. The README
  lists commands, input files and generated results.

seeds.tex.caption:
Identity-column contrast ranges over three construction seeds; seed 0 is in
  Table~\ref{tab:main}. Fresh clean records are fixed while errors are redrawn.
